# Roman Resenchuk

> iOS and macOS developer since 2011 and agentic AI developer. Builds native Swift and SwiftUI apps, and custom AI agent harnesses, autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration and MCP tool integrations. Open for freelance and contract projects, full-time senior roles and technical partnerships.

## Services
- iOS and macOS app development: iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac apps in Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit and AppKit, from concept to App Store release
- AI features in Apple apps: Apple Foundation Models, Vision, Apple Intelligence
- Agentic AI development: custom agent harnesses (rules, skills, subagents, hooks), autonomous long-running agents, multi-agent orchestration
- Tool and MCP integrations: remote MCP servers, OAuth, Cloudflare Workers

## Work
- [CloudShots: Screenshot History](https://www.resrom.com/project?name=cloudshots): iPhone, iPad and Mac screenshot search with on-device text recognition and Apple Intelligence. Runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Built with Swift 6, one shared Swift package for three apps and two extensions, GRDB, CloudKit sync through the user's own iCloud, Vision, Foundation Models, MLX, ScreenCaptureKit, 2,800+ tests.
- [Telegram Checkers](https://www.resrom.com/project?name=telegramcheckers): checkers bot and fullscreen Mini App in Telegram with friend invites, spectators and a bot opponent. Built with TypeScript, Hono, Cloudflare Workers, D1, Drizzle, Telegram Bot API, Telegram Stars.
- [Marcus: Second Brain](https://github.com/romacv/marcus-source-code): open-source remote MCP memory server for Claude, ChatGPT and Perplexity. Built with TypeScript, Hono, Cloudflare Workers, OAuth, 120+ tests.
- [Claude Usage Guard](https://github.com/romacv/claude-usage-guard): stands a long-running Claude Code session down before its rate limit and resumes it automatically. Built with shell hooks, a skill and a one-shot cron.
- [Claude Code Plan Usage Statusline](https://github.com/romacv/claude-plan-usage-statusline): status line showing real plan headroom, goals and loops. Built with Ruby, shell.
- [All projects](https://www.resrom.com/projects)
